components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.description: Button Component A versatile button component with multiple visual variants and sizes. Inspired by shadcn/ui with CSS variable theming support.

components.name: icon
components.title: Icon
components.description: Icon Components SVG icons based on Lucide icon definitions. Each icon component directly returns an SVG element. Based on lucide-static v0.562.0 icon definitions.

components.name: popover
components.title: Popover
components.description: Popover Components A floating panel that appears relative to a trigger element. Inspired by shadcn/ui Popover with CSS variable theming support. State management uses createContext/useContext for parent-child communication. Root Popover manages open state, children consume via context. Features: - ESC key to close - Click outside to close - Non-modal (no scroll lock, no focus trap) - Accessibility (aria-expanded, data-state)

components.name: resizable
components.title: Resizable
components.description: Resizable Panel Components Accessible resizable panel groups with drag and keyboard support. Inspired by shadcn/ui wrapping react-resizable-panels.

components.name: slot
components.title: Slot
components.description: Slot Component A polymorphic component that merges its props with its child element. Inspired by @radix-ui/react-slot. This enables the `asChild` pattern used by components like Button and Badge.
